title: feat: refine AI chat experience
body:
## Summary
- refine the full-page AI chat layout with a cleaner ChatGPT-style content rail and lightweight toolbar
- summarize agent tool activity for end users while keeping debug mode for raw reasoning and tool details
- preserve chat display state across refreshes and improve conversation title fallbacks in the sidebar
- add i18n labels, docs, and a changeset for the chatbot/app-shell/types updates

## Verification
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test -- ChatbotEnhanced
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test -- useConversationList ConversationsSidebar
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check
- git diff --check
- Browser verified /ai conversation layout, tool summary display, and sidebar title fallback on localhost:5180

Note: left unstaged unrelated ObjectView.tsx trailing-newline change out of this PR.
